translations.web: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
translations.bsb: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He denies the craving of the wicked.
translations.kjv: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
translations.asv: Jehovah will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish; But he thrusteth away the desire of the wicked.
